details: Idea I1 allgather_combine: replace two-level gather+root-finalize+mcast-back with mcast all-gather + local finalize. Read writer kernel baseline.
I2 colvalid_payload: shrink cross-core stat payload from whole tile to faces 0+2 (column-0-valid). Beginning orientation.
I3 cskip_finalize: scope finalize SFPU to even-parity vectors within VectorMode::C faces
I5 apply fusion: fuse x*rstd and *gamma passes, delete cb_normed roundtrip. Reading op kernels + eltwise_chain.
I6 sumsq_reduce_merge: collapse sumsq_block + reduce_stat_block into one phase, delete cb_stat_sq round trip. Read rms_norm_compute.cpp + device-zone-scope-attribution.md

I7 worksplit_retune: read _select_candidates/_admissible_by_balance/_tree_for_box + perf_zone_harness; grid 11x10 => achievable G in {1,2,5,10,11,22,55,110} (G uniquely determines (gc,gr)); plan: monkeypatch MIN/MAX_W_GROUP_SIZE + record selection via _select_regime wrapper
I4 scaler_offpath: read reader/compute/reduce helpers; building isolated bench in perf_experiments/scaler_offpath

perf_experiments/colvalid_payload: copied writer -> writer_colvalid.cpp with RMSN_PAYLOAD_MODE (0=whole tile baseline, 1=faces0+2 2txn, 2=3/4-tile prefix 1txn) + RMSN_POISON_ODD_FACES; bench.py patches only kernels[1].kernel_source+defines on the REAL program descriptor, reports ns AND pcc from one dispatch.

decode G sweep done (all PCC>=0.99998). decode7168: G110=8899/8935/9113, G55=9089, G22=9310, G11=9707, G10=16606, G5=19693, G2=27886. KEY: on a decode shape tensor_row_tiles=1 so only ONE group is active => G IS the active-core count; shrinking G shrinks parallelism 1:1. Current pick G=110 is best-or-tied on 7168/5120; G=11 marginally best on 2304/1024 (2-4%, at the 5% noise band)

cskip_finalize: kernel + host bench with 8 variants (copy_only, rc_pair, c_pair=baseline, cskip_pair, c_fused, cskip_fused, cskip_fused_bitexact, rc_fused). Found: todays chain has TWO distinct SFPU element types so chain_sfpu_inits_uniform_v=false -> both SFPU inits re-emitted PER TILE; fusing to one element makes it uniform and boot-hoists init.

Read eltwise_chain.hpp/.inl. KEY: DestReuseBinary is the only DEST-consuming FPU element and has no BroadcastDim (hpp:518-520) -> fused chain needs one operand expanded to full tiles. Two distinct math-MOP element types make chain_math_mop_uniform false (inl:2277) -> init+reconfig re-emitted per BLOCK ITERATION (inl:2709 from :3105), so blk amortizes it. New candidate found: expand RSTD (ROWS_T tiles) instead of GAMMA (COLS tiles) via UnaryBcast<Col> - far cheaper prep than Refinement 4 assumed. Wrote apply_kernel.cpp (5 variants) + apply_bench.py + bakeoff.py.

Merged phase inexpressible with helpers: eltwise_chain runs non-pack elements per TILE inside the wt loop (no per-row finalize hook); ckl::reduce incl AccumulateViaAdd only reads reduce-dim tiles from an L1 CB and sums rather than squares. Candidate uses the same primitives both helpers use internally. 5 variants: baseline, baseline_norecfg, baseline_accadd, merged, merged_hoist

perf_experiments/allgather_combine: combine_dataflow.cpp (3 modes: baseline tree / leader all-gather / flat all-gather), combine_compute.cpp (op chain code verbatim), combine_bench.py host, harness.py runner. Arrival protocol = monotone flag words in page 1 of a host-zeroed pinned zero-tile shard (no atomics, no sender-in-rect exclusion); slot-reuse back-pressure = ag_free counter, G-1 acks, skipped at block 0.

Focus shape decode7168 medians of 3: G110=8606 G55=8964 G22=9190 G11=9699. Current pick (G=110) is the MEASURED BEST; the ideas premise (smaller G) is 12.7% SLOWER at G=11. Zones show why: shrinking G grows rd_in_issue 201->767, rd_gamma_tile 1030->1484, TRISC-KERNEL 6230->7436, while the level-2 rendezvous it removes (wr_gather2_sem_wait) is only 653ns. Combine is SKEW-bound not fan-in-bound. ONE real win found elsewhere: decode1024 G=11 (5471/5576/5639) vs default G=22 (5733..6301) = -6.7%

I4 focus (110 cores, C=2): baseline 3174; after_issue 2959; after_push 2893; cheap_first 3095; cheap_after_push 2883; writer_prep 2752 (-422, 1.15x). Poisoned cheap scaler = bit-identical output => whole-tile NoC zero-fill unnecessary for SUM/REDUCE_ROW

Zone A/B at W=1024 explains the one win: G=22 two-stage adds cp_gather2_wait 573 + cp_combine_l2 183 (+811ns of combine chain) and widens wr_mcast_recv 1823->2730, while C=3->2 saves <200ns (rd_in_issue 198->158, cp_sumsq 253->206). Net +602ns = the measured 5414->6016. Turn map (flat G=11 vs best two-stage, medians): gain=1 tile W1024 5520 vs 5980 (flat wins 7.7%); gain=2 W1280 5814 vs 5900 and W1536 6041 vs 6200 (flat/tied); gain=5 W2304 6453 vs 6444 (tie); gain=7 W3072 7118 vs 6740 (two-stage wins 5.3%); gain=13/18 W5120/7168 two-stage wins 7/12%. => predicate MIN_TWO_STAGE_TILE_GAIN=4 tiles

Focus geometry (1 tile-row x 3 hidden tiles), per-block ns from iters slope: baseline(op-faithful)=566, fused_rstd blk1=666 blk8=642, fused_gamma=739/715, fused_sfpu=1960 (3.4x slower, but BEST precision ratio_med 0.99992 vs 0.99805), fold_gamma=660/621. FUSION IS A MEASURED REGRESSION (+13% at best). Real wins are per-pass fixed cost: drop 2nd-stage data-format reconfig = 480 ns (-15%), drop all reconfig = 458 (-19%), bulk output lifecycle = 479 (-15%). All variants PASS pcc>=0.99999. Fixed my own fused_sfpu bug: CopyTile of a ROW-0-valid gamma tile multiplies the junk rows; UnaryBcast<Row> into D1 is the fix.

focus decode7168: m0=8936 m1=9090 m2=8815 ns (pcc all 0.999985). bshard1024: m0=50450 m1=47845(-5.2%) m2=49049(-2.8%). wshard1024: 4564/4384/4470. wshard7168: 5819/5753/5841. POISON (NaN face1 + -Inf face3 in every unwritten face): pcc UNCHANGED in all modes -> no zero-fill needed; zone attribution on bshard: wr_gather_issue 6291->3839, wr_gather_sem_wait 5367->2655, cp_gather_wait 7270->4684 (bytes, not txn count, dominate).

VERDICT: NULL on the focus shape (G=110 already optimal, ideas premise disproved), WIN off-focus. Rule MIN_TWO_STAGE_TILE_GAIN=4 verified monkeypatched: decode1024 5892->5362 (-9.0%), decode1536 6270->5942 (-5.2%), decode1280 5870->5683 (-3.2%), (1,1,128,1024) 6570->6170 (-6.1%); pick UNCHANGED and ns flat on decode2304/3072/5120/7168, wtail, rm_interleaved, ragged5119, wide4096, all 4 prefill, and all 4 sharded (sharded never runs _select_regime - verified, SEL empty). PCC >= 0.99998 at all 200+ swept points. Artifact ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/worksplit_retune/ (sweep.py + proposed_rule.diff + zones/). Kernels were last touched 11:36, all my runs 11:48-12:20 => one consistent kernel state.

N=16 bf16: math-thread ns c_pair(baseline)=7580, cskip_pair=4426, c_fused=7539, cskip_fused=3987, cskip_fused_bitexact=4148, rc_pair=14475, copy_only floor=1070. Whole kernel 7717 -> 4133 = 1.87x. ALL variants BIT-EXACT on column 0 vs baseline. Cost tracks vector-op count; fusion alone is flat (fused body costs add+rsqrt in one vector).

I6 REGRESSION. merged_cvalid (best merged form) vs baseline per-block steady-state: focus_r1_c3 433.4 vs 407.3 (0.94x), decode_r1_c16 765.9 vs 742.8 (0.97x), bshard_r16_c4 5574 vs 2942 (0.53x), prefill_r5_c112 15538 vs 14788 (0.95x), tail 808 vs 686 (0.85x), chunked 767 vs 1072 (1.40x). Mechanism: SFPU within-tile collapse costs +115ns/tile-row vs pack+unpack+FPU reduce_tile; 1/W multiply costs +60ns (VectorMode::C) or +107ns (RC) that the reduce scaler carries free; merge saves only ~75-90ns per BLOCK of phase-boundary reconfig. ADJACENT WIN: baseline_onechain (one eltwise_chain over the whole slice, FPU reduce kept, helpers only) = 1.436x on the chunked regime, flat elsewhere, pcc slightly better.

allgather (assigned idea) is a REGRESSION: focus 11x10 21874ns vs baseline 3990ns; wshard_7x4 5807 vs 2918; wshard_8x1 (1 broadcast) flat. Mechanism: concurrent multicasts to the same rect do NOT overlap, ~13-18ns per destination per broadcast, so S senders cost Sx one broadcast (flat_allgather at 110 senders = 162753ns = 110x). Added MODE 4 sum_mcast (root broadcasts the SUM, every core finalizes locally, ONE broadcast): flat everywhere so far. All variants correctness-gated OK incl. multi-block slot reuse. NOTE: removed all MaybeDeviceZoneScope from bench kernels - the shared TT_METAL_HOME zone_src_locations.log is at 66KB and new markers hit a 16-bit hash collision (TT_THROW in profiler.cpp:283).

Domain sweep (per-block ns, single core, bf16/HiFi2/fp32_dest=False). baseline | rc2off | blk6+bulk | fused_rstd_blk6 | fused_gamma_blk6: (1,3) 566|480|518|642|715 ; (1,16) 1777|1680|1336|1834|2408 ; (3,32) 9247|9155|6136|9147|10352 ; (16,4) 6514|6436|4059|6849|6515 ; (1,112) 10669|10563|6753|10465|14710. FUSION = NULL-to-REGRESSION everywhere (best case flat at wide blocks). Biggest lever found instead: DEST-lane blocking of the EXISTING two-pass baseline, 1.09x-1.60x. Also found two hard constraints: (a) DestReuseBinary at HiFi2 is INCORRECT at blk=8 (all 8 DEST lanes, pcc 0.982, amax 5.6) but correct at blk<=6 - suspect the is_high_fidelity INCRWC(CR_D) at llk_math_eltwise_binary.h:497-503 walking off the last dest tile; (b) blk>1 with ReservePolicy::PerTile output HANGS (reserve 1 page, pack inner_count) - eltwise_chain does not static_assert it.

VERDICT WIN on byte-heavy collectives, NULL on focus. medians: decode7168 8928/8953/8929 (m0/m1/m2, flat); bshard1024 50453/47935(-5.0%)/49330(-2.2%); wshard7168 5844/5698(-2.5%)/5767; wshard1024 4564/4421(-3.1%)/4500. Poison proves no zero-fill needed; --dev watcher clean. Domain: applies everywhere, no exceptions. Artifact ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/colvalid_payload/

WIN. cskip_pair (even-parity stride, 2 elements) wins everywhere: math-thread 1.10x@N=1, 1.35x@N=2, 1.55x@N=4, 1.72x@N=16, 1.74x@N=32; bit-exact col0; same for fp32_dest_acc_en=True. cskip_fused adds 1.90x@N=16/1.97x@N=32 but REGRESSES 0.84x at N=1 (focus shape rows_t=1) -> menu item, not the unified path. SFPU cost exactly proportional to vector count (64:32:16 -> 13405:6498:3339 ns). CopyTile head is INEXPRESSIBLE to remove: eltwise_chain runs DEST-only elements inside the DestAccumulation inner loop on the transient lane, no post-accumulation hook.

I4 final: focus (110c,C=2,no tail) interleaved 4x medians prep_first 3007 / after_push 2874 / writer_prep 2779. Tail regime (110c,C=3,mask) 2x: 3977 / 3802 / 3353 (writer_prep -624, 1.19x). after_push STARVES the mask consumer (cp_sumsq 216->616). Cheap no-zero-fill scaler valid for FULL fill only.

Recommend relocating BOTH reader constants (prepare_reduce_mask then prepare_reduce_scaler) to the top of rms_norm_writer.cpp, ahead of wr_zero_fill. Monotone: BRISC and NCRISC start together so scaler ready-time is unchanged while NCRISC sheds 317-620ns.

VERDICT REGRESSION for I5 (apply fusion). fp32 corner measured: dest-reuse is precision-NEUTRAL vs the L1 round trip at fp32/HiFi2 (0.988279 vs 0.988258) AND fp32/HiFi4 (0.997919 vs 0.997919, pcc 1.000000, fused amax LOWER) - Refinement 4 objection (ii) is measurably false. Perf at fp32 HiFi4 (1,16): baseline 2565 vs fused 3348 (+31 pct). 64-core grid run reproduces single-core per-block numbers exactly. Attribution of the win that IS there: bulk output lifecycle 1.15x-1.26x, then DEST-lane blocking a further 1.1x-1.25x (combined up to 1.60x at 16x4); both are per-pass fixed-cost levers on the EXISTING two-pass shape, not fusion. Artifact: ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/apply_fusion/

VERDICT REGRESSION for the assigned mcast all-gather. focus_11x10: baseline 3990/4196 ns, allgather 21874 (5.3x slower), flat_allgather 162753-173868 (~42x). Mechanism measured across 5 fan-outs: ~13-18 ns per destination per broadcast, additive across senders => multicasts into one rectangle do not overlap; the baseline is already at the minimum broadcast count (1). SALVAGE sum_mcast (same tree, ONE broadcast, root sends the SUM, every core finalizes locally): flat everywhere at 1 block, 1.12x at 4 blocks and 1.17x at 16 blocks on the 110-core two-stage box, reproducible over 4 reads; flat on 28-core boxes even at 4 blocks and on the block-sharded 8-core groups. SIDE FINDING: baseline_nohs (mcast_pipe PRE_HANDSHAKE cleared) = 3470 vs 3990 ns at focus_11x10. Correctness: 38 passed / 2 skipped in test_allgather_combine.py across all variants, incl. multi-block slot reuse and 8 concurrent groups.
